page.overview:
Who is Derek Adams?

Derek Adams is a character created by Scottish author William Meikle for his Midnight Eye Files series of occult detective stories. He made his first appearance in the 2005 novel The Amulet, and has since appeared in at least fifteen different stories.

Adams is a hard-drinking, heavy-smoking private detective based in Glasgow, Scotland, he is a man with an open mind and a certain experience in dealing with the supernatural. His encounters with the bizarre include foiling the plans of Cthulhu cultists to bring their master to Earth, a run-in with brain-snatching Mi-Go, and a team-up with Arkham private dick Frank Nardi while on the case of mysterious signals from the great beyond.

Once a student at Glasgow University studying Organic Chemistry and Molecular Biology, while in attendance Adams met and fell in love with a woman named Liz. During the course of their occasionally-stormy relationship Liz, unbeknownst to Adams, became pregnant; during a drunken row where she attempted to explain her situation to him, Adams left Liz alone and returned to the bar. During his absence, Liz committed suicide.

Attempting to reestablish his life, Adams took a course in journalism, eventually landing a menial position on a local rag. However, this failed to hold his interest, and he began to drink heavily.
